columns.order: result schema ordinal; stable ordinal IDs; duplicate names permitted
columns.truncation: none; out-of-bounds inputs return table fallback

canonical.schema: ordered column array with name, optional explicit semantic type and rows as equal-length arrays
canonical.type_resolution: Explicit valid semantic type wins; otherwise identifier if ASCII lowercase column name is id, uuid or ends _id and all nonmissing values are strings or safe integers; temporal if all nonmissing values are valid ISO date-only or RFC3339 timestamp strings with explicit offset; quantitative if all nonmissing values are finite numbers excluding boolean; nominal otherwise including all missing. Explicit incompatible types reject input.
canonical.missing: null, NaN, infinity, empty string; whitespace-only strings are valid; nested values rejected; missing cells represented by true in per-cell mask outside model inputs
canonical.numeric: IEEE binary64, safe integer range, normalize negative zero; temporal values UTC seconds; typed equality; no coercion of numeric strings
canonical.statistics: N total rows, M total columns, n nonmissing observations in column, K typed distinct nonmissing values; numeric-only statistics apply to quantitative columns; temporal steps only temporal; population moments; exact median and type-7 quantile (linear interpolation at (n-1)p); fewer than two adjacent pairs for temporal step CV => 0; no pairs => 0; constant variance => 0 for standardized moments
canonical.float: binary64 intermediates; finite result clipped to declared range then float32 round-to-nearest-even; nonfinite defaults; parity atol=1e-6 rtol=1e-6
canonical.lexer: ASCII case-insensitive unquoted keyword tokens; whitespace and comments excluded; single-quoted strings and quoted identifiers are opaque single tokens, escaped doubled delimiters honored; support SQL line and block comments, brackets, backticks and double quotes; punctuation and operators separate tokens; lexical only, not execution or full AST; malformed/unclosed quote or comment rejects inference
canonical.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, ordered schema and rows; nonfinite values normalized null before serialization; SHA256 exact contract file bytes including final LF

model_io.score_semantics: probabilities in class order; sum to one per row within numerical tolerance; not final-chart confidence
model_io.final_classes: See chart-taxonomy-v1.md; 21 deterministic outputs; kpi_card input alias only
